messages:
ana: Heads up — midnight-archiver cron failed on staging (and flapped in prod). nightly-bench CI turned red after the job timeout. 504 on S3 put. scheduler retried once.
ci-bot: Job `midnight-archiver` failed: exit 1. Full logs: https://internal.s3/redwood/logs/2256789012/archiver.log
jamie: can you paste the last 20 lines of the log here?
ana: sure — pasting snippet below.
ana: ```
2026-03-17T04:00:12Z ERROR put_object failed: 504 Gateway Timeout
2026-03-17T04:00:13Z WARN transient s3 error, attempt 2/3
2026-03-17T04:00:15Z ERROR attempt 3/3 failed -> aborting
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "archiver.py", line 342, in run
    client.put_object(... )
  File "botocore", line 1043, in put_object
S3GatewayTimeout: 504
```
jamie: looks like transient S3 gateway timeout. did retries/backoff kick in? current config is linear backoff with fixed sleeps.
sree: tagging for bisect — last deploy changed upload batching. @mike can you do a quick git bisect between `a1b2c3d` and `f6g7h8i` to see when batch size changed?
mike: I can start bisect but noisy failures might be noisy. I'll narrow window and report the commit if consistent.
ops-bot: scheduler retried job 2/3 — next automatic retry scheduled in 10m.
ana: I'm queuing a manual rerun for staging now to see if it clears. also want to try lowering batch size for a quick check.
ci-bot: nightly-bench rerun started (job id 67890) :eyes:
mike: bisect started locally. I'll run until I hit a reproducible fail or narrow to a single commit. won't block the staged rerun.
jamie: ftr — 504 usually means upstream throttling or a short outage. adding exponential backoff + jitter is low-risk and helps.
ana: agreed. I'm opening a tiny PR to flip to exponential backoff and reduce default batch size. @sree can you review? PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1234
sree: will review after standup. if it's small we can hotfix-staging today, then roll to prod with canary.
mike: bisect result: narrowed to commit `d4e5f6a` which increased default batch size and removed jitter. that's likely the trigger.
ana: excellent catch. action items: 1) merge backoff + batch-size PR, 2) rerun prod once merged and monitor for 30m, 3) mark CI nightly-bench as transient and requeue full CI rerun. anyone object?
jamie: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: manual rerun requested by ana — queued.
ci-bot: nightly-bench CI rerun scheduled (build 78901).
ana: I'll update the internal incident ticket and assign ownership to eng-ml oncall. thanks for the quick help — please ping here if rerun still flakes.
mike: got it. i'll follow up and prepare a short postmortem blurb if this shows up again. :shipit:
